context: An elderly couple tends to their garden
purpose: Teach: 苗/家屋/つない/下ろし/映る/はめ/お宅/森田

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 今年も、苗を植える時期だな。
lines.en: It's seedling-planting time again this year.
lines.style: Quiet, unhurried observation. The steady voice of someone who has marked seasons this way for decades. A touch of gentle inevitability—not weary, just aware of the cycle turning.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、家屋の裏の畑、孫と一緒にやりましょう。
lines.en: Yes—we'll do the patch behind the house, with the grandchild.
lines.style: Warm agreement, present-tense planning. Brightens at the mention of including the grandchild. Matter-of-fact and affectionate at once, the voice of someone who knows what she wants to happen.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 物置の鍵、つないだままにしてあるね。
lines.en: The storage-shed key is still chained up where it should be.
lines.style: Steady confirmation. Quiet attention to detail—checking that small systems are holding. No urgency, just the voice of someone noting what's in order.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 重い荷物、下ろしておいたわ。
lines.en: I've already taken the heavy things down.
lines.style: Practical, slightly matter-of-fact. A hint of quiet pride in having handled it. Soft and unhurried—the work was done without fuss, and she's simply reporting it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 池に夕日が映る、いつ見ても良いな。
lines.en: The sunset reflecting in the pond—it's always good to see, no matter how many times.
lines.style: Gently wistful, almost meditative. Pause weight on 'always.' The voice of someone stopping to notice something that doesn't change, finding peace in that constancy.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 網戸、ちゃんとはめておいてね。
lines.en: Make sure you fit the screen door in properly.
lines.style: Practical instruction, warm undertone. Not a demand—more the voice of someone who cares that things be done right. Slight caring firmness, no edge.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お宅の梅干し、また分けてもらおうか、森田さんに。
lines.en: Maybe we should ask Morita-san to share some of their pickled plums again.
lines.style: Gentle suggestion, warmth and community woven through. Soft close, almost thinking aloud. The voice of someone who knows how to ask without burden—generosity as reciprocal kindness.
